answer: Divergent-challenge registration: each identity must return a fresh challenge whose answer depends on a per-identity secret and a shared daily random seed, so every clone of one operator returns identical answers and collapses into a single identity. Enforcement splits the shared reward pool only among distinct answers, so a clone farm's marginal clones add no payout while still paying the full per-challenge compute cost in nectar. The operator also loses umber credits per duplicate detected, and honest agents earn a delta bonus for answer diversity, making cloning strictly negative.
